insights.title: Crazy w3i Dog
descriptions:
The Web3 Innovation Lab is supported by a network of independent Web3 contributors who aim to develop a self-sustaining, blockchain-based organization.

A small core team based in Germany is responsible for developing the methodological framework to anchor the principle of community-driven product ownership within a DAO.
The Web3 Innovation Lab is a methodological framework designed to build a self-sustaining Web3 ecosystem.
It follows a modular structure of six stages/levels, gradually leading to a fully decentralized autonomous organization (DAO).

The project was established as a privately funded initiative, intentionally without venture capital, in order to ensure independence, sustainability, and long-term resilience.
The core product is the Ideation Market â a combination of an NFT marketplace and a DEX aggregator for functional Web3 use cases.
Focus on application-oriented utility tokens, such as digital twins, rights, infrastructure, and access.

Operated by a user- and community-governed DAO with a collectively managed treasury and on-chain contributor roles.

titleDescriptionPairs.title: Description
descriptions:
The tokens document and represent the operational framework of the Web3 Innovation Lab.
Their on-chain publication is intended to serve as an open-source reference.

Use and reproduction of the described concept are permitted. Intellectual property remains with the Web3 Innovation Lab Community (ENS: Web3InnovationLab.eth).

titleDescriptionPairs.title: Usage Rights
descriptions: Access to the Ideation Pool, including voting and governance rights.
Ownership of all 7 NFTs establishes a right to request the development of a DAO concept (design by the Lab, implementation and operation by the holder).
Eligibility for future NFT and token distributions.

titleDescriptionPairs.title: Intellectual Property
descriptions: Rights holder: Web3 Innovation Lab Community (ENS: Web3InnovationLab.eth).
License agreement recorded on-chain (NFT metadata + IPFS).
NFTs are defined as community intellectual property, not as individual property of holders.

titleDescriptionPairs.title: Term and Expiry
descriptions: The license is linked to the token and remains valid as long as the token is held. No expiry date applies.

Termination is possible through:

Sale or transfer (rights end for the previous holder).

Community decision (e.g., exclusion from the Ideation Pool).

Loss or compromise of the ENS (transition regulated by governance processes).

titleDescriptionPairs.title: Upgrade Policy
descriptions:
The Lab may introduce extensions or services at any time.

        Open extensions are free to use.

        Proprietary extensions are subject to separate licensing.

The project is currently in its launch phase and is seeking strategic partners who share the vision of a purpose-driven economy.

Goal: To build a network of innovators, corporates, VCs, infrastructure providers, and communities in order to enable sustainable ecosystem growth.
